completionHelper.readScope: Only observeDefinitions and directory methods plus surrounding declared interface; not an independent whole partition/helper review

scope: Optional supplemental storage, absent-second-plan branch, retained destination run, complete presentation operation ownership, current ticket checks, final synchronous body and cancellation/drain. Root owns strict descriptor/provenance/partition and cold-reference correctness.

findings.evidence: executeWithOrdinaryProperties and withOwnedOperation are whole-text unchanged. The registered typed task surrounds the actual inDestination invocation, its final destination session/presentation validation, the actor entry into finishOrdinary and the outer ticket/cancellation checks. There is no producer task inserted into the original source account's cleanup join.
findings.implication: The existing late destination-result and external invalidation ownership boundary is retained.

findings.evidence: produceOrdinary acquires one run before either stage, builds destination admission from it, and passes that same run to unchanged produce(requiredDestinationRun:). All subsequent authorizations use that retained destination admission.
findings.implication: The overlap branch does not reacquire or silently switch destination run between stages.

findings.topic: Only an actual missing plan owns supplemental effects
findings.evidence: ordinaryStorage is optional and constructed only under if let plan = stage.completion.missingPlan. The second executor, verifier and completed-checkpoint read are in that same conditional branch. In the absent-plan branch, checkpoint and verification are explicitly nil.
findings.implication: All-present input creates no empty plan, second executor/verifier invocation, new supplemental journal, or invented second native completion.

findings.topic: Original admission remains retained in either branch
findings.evidence: preservationStorage is always created from the actual preservation binding and held in OrdinaryPrepared through the full E invocation. Each authorize checks the current ticket, original and optional storage, retained destination admission, storage again and current ticket. The pending callback latch is installed before first suspension.
findings.implication: Making the supplemental storage optional does not drop original scope admission or permit a second callback to enter.

findings.topic: Current observations stay within the destination callback
findings.evidence: Reused definitions are observed before new supplemental effects, and all selected definitions are observed before callback completion. The read method invokes the passed authorize before/after bounded current definition reads and namespace observations. Source revalidation and destination authorizations finish before produceOrdinary returns.
findings.implication: This is sequential current observation under the existing lease/run checks, not an atomic global schema snapshot. Exact descriptor/reuse semantics are for the separate Root peer.

findings.topic: Final completion preserves optionality and returns retained values
findings.evidence: finishOrdinary checks the supplied references/checkpoint digests against its retained OrdinaryPrepared value, revalidates original and optional storage, rereads the original checkpoint, conditionally rereads only a real supplemental checkpoint, and rebuilds/compares the reference. It checks the ticket again, clears only its pending result and returns the retained expected completion.
findings.implication: An adapter cannot substitute a verification/directory result merely by returning matching reference bytes. All-present mode keeps the second checkpoint absent through final delivery.

findings.topic: No new final source/native await or cleanup cycle
findings.evidence: finishOrdinary has a synchronous actor-isolated body with no source/native await. Calling it still requires the existing actor hop after E returns; the final App persistence boundary remains separately owned. executeWithOrdinaryProperties catches errors, discards only the matching pending ticket and rethrows. External invalidate, source revalidate and withOwnedOperation bodies are byte-identical.
findings.implication: No new wait edge or second-scope drain was introduced by this delta. Cooperative cancellation and existing source-close retry obligations remain.

limitations: No parser, semantic typecheck, component test, native account, or Apple application proof is established by this source review.
The new partition helper, Context/Owner cold routing and exact descriptor/provenance enforcement require the separate Root functional peer.
The final actor hop and App post-return persistence are not an atomic remote transaction or a lasting native authority grant.
Callbacks must await their owned work and cooperate with cancellation; no new cleanup timeout or forced task termination is introduced.
New branch controls are still in preparation. No existing method pass is replayed or relabeled.
The frozen semantic131 graph and its original20 method selection are unchanged and do not include this later proposal.
